cases.mechanism_detail: A disease-specific SVA in a TAF1 intron is associated with decreased TAF1 (and DRD2) expression in caudate nucleus; abnormal methylation of the SVA in patient caudate is proposed to account for reduced TAF1 expression.
cases.quote: We also identified an abnormal pattern of DNA methylation in the retrotransposon in the genome from the patient's caudate, which could account for decreased expression of TAF1.
